+# Acceptance Criteria
+
+Rules:
+
+- Criteria lines use the exact format `- ACn: <criterion>`.
+- Every criterion ends with [verify: exec `<command>`],
+  [verify: invariant `<command>`], [verify: judged] or
+  [verify: none — <reason>].
+- After `flow freeze` this file is checksum-protected: any edit outside
+  `keryx flow ac update` fails every gate and status transition.
+- Completion requires every ACn to be confirmed via
+  `keryx flow ac confirm <id> <ACn>`.
+
+## Criteria
+
+- AC1: The PR lane function reads no field of the local review: a model test iterates every local review state (none, queued, running, awaiting answer, ready, partial, publication pending, outdated) for the same GitHub card and gets the same lane; the attention lane and the Keryx "In review" lane no longer exist (R1, D6, spec AC1) · sensitive: mutation [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review/model.test.ts`]
+- AC2: On the Pull requests board, a local review starting, finishing or being published changes neither the lane, the position nor the visibility of the card (a DOM test updates `localReview` on a shown card and asserts the same lane and index); cards are ordered by `updatedAt` descending (R1) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review/ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx`]
+- AC3: Default grouping "Status" shows Draft · Waiting for review (no decision or REVIEW_REQUIRED) · Changes requested · Approved, with Merged and Closed only when the state filter includes them; grouping "My role" shows Requested from me · Mine · Others; quick filters "Requested from me", "Mine" and "CI failed" narrow the board; every shown card satisfies all filters and the search (no active-review bypass, a test with an active review and a non-matching author shows nothing); a lane that cannot hold a card under the current filters is not drawn (R2, spec AC2, AC13) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review`]
+- AC4: The card reason line is derived from GitHub data only; Keryx review state appears only in the work row [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review`]
+- AC5: Every PR card and list row renders a Keryx work row with exactly three slots (review, Flow, session) whose DOM structure is the same with zero and with three links, and the row has a fixed height in `apps/desktop/src/styles/review.css`; the review slot shows the state from `localReview` without a round number or behind count and opens the current review panel; the Flow slot shows "Flow #<id> · <stage>" and opens the Flow; empty slots show the labelled actions "Run review", "Create Flow", "Open in session" (R4 part, R7, spec AC14) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review`]
+- AC6: Every action on a PR card, PR list row and Issue card has a visible text label (a DOM test asserts non-empty text content for each action control); "Fix review comments" is not shown in this stage (R7 part, spec AC15 part) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review src/issues`]
+- AC7: "Open in session" on a PR with no bound session creates a new session bound to the PR Subject and prefills the composer with the PR URL without sending it; pressing it again opens the same session (newest non-archived bound session); the session slot menu lists the bound sessions and "New session", which creates another bound session (R5, spec AC8 part) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]
+- AC8: Subject storage: `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` {kind "pr"|"issue", repo, number, url}, refuses an invalid one, persists it in `flags.json` so a fresh read (restart) returns it, and `null` unlinks it; an Issue session bound by `withIssueBinding` carries `subject.kind = "issue"`; when keryx replies without `subject`, Desktop still opens the session and shows a notice that the binding was not saved (spec AC8, failure scenario) [verify: exec `bun test src/session/organize.test.ts src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts src/session/issues`]
+- AC9: "Create Flow" on a PR card opens the PR-bound session with a prefilled flow prompt naming the PR URL; the first new flow package that appears while that request is pending is linked to the session (`flow` flag) and shown as the Flow link on that PR card; when several new packages appear, none is linked automatically (R6) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]
+- AC10: In a PR-bound session, `/review` without a target opens the launch dialog with that PR preselected, and the review started there appears as the review link on that PR card without a manual refresh (R6, spec AC9) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]
+- AC11: Issues board default grouping is by GitHub state (Open · Closed, Closed drawn only when the state filter includes closed issues); GitHub Project grouping is unchanged; the Flow stage filter is gone; issues without a Flow are spread over the GitHub columns (R3, spec AC12) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]
+- AC12: Each Issue card has a work row with a Flow slot (link with stage, or "Create Flow") and a session slot (bound sessions found through `subject`, or "Open in session") [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]
+- AC13: The default Issues source is the project repository: `keryx issues list` with `source: "repository"` lists `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues` of the repository resolved from the project cwd and excludes pull requests; "Assigned to me" and the other sources stay selectable and a stored source preference wins (D5) [verify: exec `bun test src/integrations/issues-board.test.ts && cd apps/desktop && bun test src/issues`]
+- AC14: The Pull requests tab attention set and indicator are preserved: `ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx` passes, and every edited line in `carriedAttention`, `seeded`, `seedFor`, `attentionPrs` or `stale` handling has a recorded one-line mutation that fails a test (journal) · sensitive: mutation [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review/ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx`]
+- AC15: `attachBadges` (`src/review/desk-run-store.ts`) and `localBadge` (`src/review/board-badges.ts`) still agree [verify: exec `bun test src/review/desk-run-store.test.ts src/review/board-badges.test.ts`]
+- AC16: Scenario "PR without Flow and review → Open in session → `/review` → review link on the card" passes as one integrated test over the App wiring (bound session created, launch dialog preselects the PR, the started run shows on the card) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]
+- AC17: The Pull requests toolbar keeps the stage 0 behaviour: no element added to `.flows-toolbar`, or, if one is added, the board toolbar is re-measured at the stage 0 widths and the result recorded in the journal [verify: judged]
+- AC18: Desktop typecheck and the full Desktop test suite pass [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src`]

+## How Issue ↔ session ↔ Flow is stored today (first step of the stage, read for this flow)
+
+- Session flags live in `<sessionDir>/flags.json` (`src/session/organize.ts`): `archivedAt`,
+  `pinnedAt`, `flow` (flow package dir). Written through the ACP extension `_keryx/session_flags`
+  (`src/acp/server.ts` `handleSessionFlags`), read into `SessionInfo._meta.keryx`
+  (`apps/desktop/src/acp/types.ts` `sessionFlags`). Desktop links a new session to a Flow through
+  `pendingFlow` + `applyPendingFlow` in `apps/desktop/src/session/useAcpSession.ts` (keryx lists a
+  session only after its first save, so the link is retried after the first turn).
+- An Issue session is bound by `src/session/issues/issue-session.ts` `withIssueBinding`: a private
+  record `<keryxDataDir>/issue-sessions/<digest>.json` (launch: issue ref, viewer, project, sessionId,
+  flow) plus a marker `<sessionDir>/issue-link.json` holding only the digest. `readSessionFlags`
+  exposes only `hasIssue: true`; Desktop cannot tell which issue a session belongs to.
+- A Flow created for an Issue records `source: {type: "github-issue", ref: <url>}` in `flow.json`
+  (`src/flow/issue-source.ts`). Flows have no PR source; a FlowCard knows a PR only via `prUrl`
+  (set by `keryx flow implemented --pr`). `FlowCard` comes from Rust (`src-tauri/src/flows`).
+- PR "Open in Sessions" (`App.tsx` `openSessionWith`) creates a new session, links it to a Flow only
+  when a Flow already has that `prUrl`, and prefills the composer with the URL. No PR binding.
+
+Decision for this flow: introduce `_meta.keryx.subject` (`flags.json` `subject`) for both kinds, as the
+specification prefers. PR sessions get it from Desktop through `_keryx/session_flags`; Issue sessions
+get it from `withIssueBinding` when the session is bound. The private issue record stays as is.
+No Rust change: `issues_request` passes the request JSON through to `keryx issues <action>`.
+
+## Code map
+
+- PR board: `apps/desktop/src/review/model.ts` (lanes, filters, reasons), `ReviewResults.tsx` (cards,
+  list), `ReviewBoard.tsx` (load, attention set, toolbar), `ReviewFilters.tsx`, `styles/review.css`.
+- Must not break: attention set in `ReviewBoard.tsx` (`carriedAttention`, `seeded`, `seedFor`,
+  `attentionPrs`, `stale`) pinned by `ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx`; `attachBadges`
+  (`src/review/desk-run-store.ts`) ≡ `localBadge` (`src/review/board-badges.ts`); toolbar container
+  queries at 1100/760px in `styles/review.css`.
+- Sessions in App: `App.tsx` (`linkedSessions`, `openSessionWith`, `workOn`, review launch dialog with
+  `draftReview.target`), `/review` parsing `session/commandRunner.ts`.
+- Issues: `apps/desktop/src/issues/model.ts` (`groupForRow`, `STAGES`, `SOURCES`, filters),
+  `IssuesBoard.tsx`, `IssueFilters.tsx`; backend `src/integrations/issues-board.ts` (`listIssuePage`,
+  REST `/issues?filter=<source>`), `src/commands/issues.ts`.
+

+
+No local Rust toolchain; Rust is verified only in CI.

+# Desktop Review v2 stage 1: GitHub slice and Keryx links on the board
+
+## Problem
+
+The Pull requests and Issues tabs mix GitHub state with Keryx state. A PR card changes lane when a
+Keryx review starts or finishes (the "Needs attention" and "In review" lanes), Issues are grouped by
+Flow stage so every issue without a Flow sits in one column, and "Open in Sessions" for a PR always
+creates a new, unbound session. A review or Flow created from such a session never returns to the card.
+
+Source: `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/` (PRD R1–R7, specification, implementation plan
+row "1. GitHub-срез и ссылки", decisions D5 and D6). Stage 0 is Flow 516 (PR #1294).
+
+## Expected outcome
+
+- Pull requests: lanes, order and visibility come from GitHub data only. Default grouping "Status"
+  (Draft · Waiting for review · Changes requested · Approved, plus Merged/Closed when the state filter
+  includes them), alternative grouping "My role", quick filters "Requested from me", "Mine",
+  "CI failed". The attention lane is gone (D6). Lanes that cannot hold cards are not drawn.
+- Every PR card has a fixed-height Keryx work row: review link (state from `localReview`, no round
+  number, no behind count; opens the current review panel), Flow link, session link; empty slots are
+  labelled actions. Card actions are labelled with text. "Fix review comments" is out of scope.
+- "Open in session" binds the session to the PR or Issue (Subject), reopens the latest bound session,
+  offers another or a new one, and the session header shows the Subject with a link back.
+- `/review` in a PR-bound session opens the launch dialog with that PR selected; the review appears as
+  a link on the card. "Create Flow" from a PR opens the bound session with a flow prompt, and the Flow
+  it creates is linked to the session and shown on the card.
+- Issues: default grouping by GitHub state (Open · Closed); Flow stage is a link on the card; the
+  default source is the project repository (D5); "Assigned to me" and the others stay selectable.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- The Review entity, Reviews tab, round number and behind count on the review link (stage 2).
+- Head movement, refresh rounds, publication options (stage 3); unified registry, "Fix review
+  comments" (stage 4).
+- Team review requests for the tab indicator (deviation (a)): stage 1 introduces no team membership,
+  so the deviation stays open and is recorded as such.
+- Rust changes in `apps/desktop/src-tauri` (not buildable locally; none planned).

+1. **Subject storage (backend).** `SessionFlags.subject = {kind: "pr" | "issue", repo: "owner/name",
+   number, url, repositoryId?}` in `flags.json`, validated on read and write (GitHub https URL whose
+   path matches kind, repo and number). `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` (object, or null to
+   unlink). `withIssueBinding` writes `{kind: "issue"}` when it binds a session. Desktop's
+   `SessionFlags` type mirrors it. An older keryx ignores the key: Desktop detects the missing
+   `subject` in the reply and says the binding was not saved.
+2. **Issues source "repository" (backend).** `ListIssueRequest.source` gains `"repository"`: REST
+   `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues` for the project's GitHub repository resolved from the command's cwd
+   (the same resolution the PR board uses), pull requests excluded, same pagination and cursor scope.
+3. **PR board GitHub-only (Desktop).** Lane function from GitHub fields only. Grouping "Status"
+   (default): Draft · Waiting for review · Changes requested · Approved · Merged · Closed; grouping
+   "My role": Requested from me · Mine · Others. Lanes that the current filters exclude are not
+   drawn. Quick filters "Requested from me", "Mine", "CI failed" are toggles in the context row (not
+   the toolbar, so the toolbar measurements of stage 0 hold). Order: `updatedAt` descending. The
+   card's reason line is GitHub-derived; Keryx state moves to the work row (slice 4). The attention
+   set and tab indicator stay as they are (deviation (b) remains).
+4. **Work row and sessions (Desktop).** A fixed-height work row on every PR card and list row with
+   three slots: review (`localReview` state text, opens the current review panel; empty: "Run
+   review"), Flow (flows with matching `prUrl` or linked to a session bound to the PR; "Flow #id ·
+   stage"; empty: "Create Flow"), session (bound sessions; count, opens the newest, menu with all and
+   "New session"; empty: "Open in session"). "Open on GitHub" and the subscription button get text
+   labels. App: open/reuse a PR-bound session (pending subject applied like `pendingFlow`), composer
+   prefilled with the URL and never sent; session header link to the Subject (PR detail in Pull
+   requests, issue in Issues) and to its Flow; `/review` without a target in a PR-bound session
+   preselects the PR; "Create Flow" opens the bound session with a flow prompt and links the first new
+   flow package that appears while that request is pending.

+Task definitions live here; task **statuses** live in flow.json and are managed
+only via `keryx flow task done <id> <taskId>`.
+
+These four are created by `keryx flow init` as a default checklist. Add your
+own with `keryx flow task add`; a scaffold row your plan supersedes is closed
+with `--disposition skipped --reason "<why>"`, not left open.

+| T1 | context | Collect remaining context |
+| T2 | implement | Implement per plan |
+| T3 | test | Add/adjust tests and make them pass |

 Три отклонения от PRD сделаны сознательно и записаны здесь:
 
 - (a) R12 говорит, что индикатор вкладки Pull requests загорается для запроса ревью на пользователя «или его команду». На этапе 0 сопоставляется только логин пользователя; запросы на команды не сопоставляются, пока не появится членство в командах (планируется вместе с этапом 1).

 - (c) Панель инструментов доски не гарантированно остаётся в одну строку, и меню для второстепенных элементов нет. Вместо этого подписи кнопок скрываются, когда внутренняя ширина панели (без отступов) не больше 1100px — это панель шириной около 1140px; текст состояния вотчера скрывается при внутренней ширине не больше 760px — панель около 800px, а счётчик pull request'ов остаётся голым числом, и поле поиска сужается до 80px; счётчик активных фильтров остаётся видимым. Измерено на разметке панели с реальными стилями и заглушками вместо данных: одна строка без выхода за край при ширине панели 560, 620, 700, 760, 820, 1101, 1180 и 1380px; при 340px — две строки. В приложении с реальными данными не измерялось.
 - (d) Решения оператора от 2026-11-23: кнопка на карточке с устаревшим ревью называется «Review again», пока этап 2 не свяжет раунды между собой; индикатор вкладки считает каждый pull request, которому нужен пользователь, а если часть из них скрыта фильтрами, на панели инструментов показывается подсказка с числом скрытых и кнопкой, которая сбрасывает фильтры и поиск.

 ### Как запускать
 
 - Один этап — один Flow через flow-orchestrator (`.metaproject/skills/gdskills/orchestration/flow-orchestrator/SKILL.md`), ветка от свежего `main`, свой PR. Критерии приёмки замораживаются из строки этапа в таблице «Этапы» и из требований PRD, которые она называет.
 - Входные документы: [PRD](prd.md) (R1–R12), [спецификация](specification.md), этот план, решения D1–D6 выше. Раздел спецификации «Основания» описывает код на коммите `1b994df18`, то есть до этапа 0; где этап 0 его изменил, верен раздел «Состояние этапа 0» этого плана.
 - Ревью — review-orchestrator по PR. Составы раундов 3–5 этапа 0 были сокращены решением оператора, и такие пакеты не проходят гейт завершения инструмента; если нужен полный пакет, запускайте полный состав.
 - Rust-часть Desktop (`apps/desktop/src-tauri`) локально не собирается — проверяется только в CI.
 
 ### Порядок и параллельность
 
 - Этапы 1 и 2 не зависят друг от друга, их можно вести параллельно. Оба трогают карточку PR (`apps/desktop/src/review/ReviewResults.tsx`, `ReviewBoard.tsx`): этап 1 добавляет строку работы Keryx и ссылку на ревью, этап 2 переносит интерфейс ревью из панели PR и добавляет к ссылке раунд и отставание. При параллельной работе договоритесь, какой Flow владеет этими файлами, или ведите этап 2 после слияния этапа 1.
 - Этап 3 начинается только после слияния этапа 2, этап 4 — после этапов 2 и 3.
 
 ### С чего начать каждый этап
 
 - **Этап 1.** Сначала прочитать, как сейчас хранится связь Issue ↔ сессия ↔ Flow (при подготовке не читалось, см. «Что не проверено»). Ссылка ревью на карточке строится из `localReview` и открывает текущую панель ревью. Здесь же закрывается отклонение (a): сопоставление запросов ревью на команды пользователя, если появится членство в командах. Колонка внимания убирается по D6, Issues по умолчанию показывают репозиторий проекта по D5.
 - **Этап 2.** Начать с миграции запусков (`src/review/desk-run-store.ts`) в раунды и попытки на копии рабочей базы. После появления вкладки Reviews индикатор вкладки Pull requests перестаёт загораться от локального ревью — это снимает отклонение (b). Подпись «Review again» из решения (d) меняется вместе со связью раундов.
